854	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.OPTIMAL_TOKEN_BASELINE)
855	def compute_optimal_token_baseline_advantage(
856	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
857	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
858	    index: np.ndarray,
859	    old_log_probs: torch.Tensor,
860	    sum_pi_squared: torch.Tensor,
861	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor = None,
862	    handle_zero_tail: bool = True,
863	    epsilon: float = 1e-8,
864	    **kwargs,
865	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
866	    """
867	    Compute advantages using Optimal Token Baseline (OTB).
868	
869	    Unlike the group mean based baseline which uses a single baseline per trajectory,
870	    this computes a unique baseline for each timestep using cumulative path variance.
871	
872	    Theory:
873	        For each timestep t in each prompt group:
874	            B_t* = E[G_t × W_t] / E[W_t]
875	        where W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t ||s_j||² (cumulative path-variance proxy)
876	        and ||s_j||² = 1 - 2π_j + Σπ²
877	
878	    The cumulative sum W_t captures the "realized energy" of trajectory has been up to timestep t,
879	    giving higher weight to predicting rewards on high-variance paths.
880	
881	    Args:
882	        token_level_rewards: Rewards at each token position [shape: (bs, response_length)]
883	        response_mask: Binary mask for valid tokens (1) vs padding (0) [shape: (bs, response_length)]
884	        index: Prompt indices for grouping trajectories from same prompt [shape: (bs,)]
885	        old_log_probs: Log probabilities from training policy during generation [shape: (bs, response_length)]
886	        sum_pi_squared: Sum of squared probabilities over vocabulary Σπ² [shape: (bs, response_length)]
887	        rollout_is_weights: Pre-computed IS weights for W correction [shape: (bs, response_length)],
888	            None if not using IS
889	        handle_zero_tail: If True, zero baselines will be set in the portion of the longest trajectory
890	            that extends beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
891	            Default: True
892	        epsilon: Small constant for numerical stability (default: 1e-8)
893	
894	    Returns:
895	        advantages: OTB advantage estimates [shape: (bs, response_length)]
896	        returns: Cumulative rewards (returns) from each position [shape: (bs, response_length)]
897	
898	    Note on Rollout Importance Sampling:
899	        When rollout_is_weights is provided, W_t is scaled by ρ̄²(t) to minimize MSE under truncated IS:
900	            B_t* = Σ[G_t × ρ̄²(t) × W_t] / Σ[ρ̄²(t) × W_t]
901	    """
902	    with torch.no_grad():
903	        batch_size, seq_len = token_level_rewards.shape
904	        device = token_level_rewards.device
905	
906	        # Compute returns (reward-to-go) for each timestep
907	        returns = (token_level_rewards * response_mask).flip(dims=[-1]).cumsum(dim=-1).flip(dims=[-1])
908	
909	        # Step 1: Compute w_per_timestep = 1 - 2π_t + Σπ²)
910	        pi_t = torch.exp(old_log_probs)
911	        w_per_timestep = 1 - 2 * pi_t + sum_pi_squared
912	
913	        # Step 2: Apply rollout importance sampling correction (if enabled)
914	        if rollout_is_weights is not None:
915	            # Scale W by ρ̄² to minimize MSE under truncated IS
916	            w_per_timestep = w_per_timestep * (rollout_is_weights**2)
917	
918	        # Step 3: Compute cumulative path-variance proxy: W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t w_j
919	        # This measures accumulated variance from the start of the trajectory up to timestep t
920	        w_cumulative = (w_per_timestep * response_mask).cumsum(dim=-1)
921	
922	        # Group trajectories by prompt
923	        prompt_groups = defaultdict(list)
924	        for i in range(batch_size):
925	            prompt_groups[index[i]].append(i)
926	
927	        # Initialize baselines tensor [batch_size, seq_len]
928	        baselines = torch.zeros_like(returns)
929	
930	        # Compute per-step baseline for each prompt group
931	        for _, trajectory_indices in prompt_groups.items():
932	            N = len(trajectory_indices)
933	            if N == 1:
934	                # Single trajectory - no baseline (advantage = return)
935	                continue
936	
937	            traj_idx = torch.tensor(trajectory_indices, device=device)
938	
939	            # Extract group data [N, seq_len]
940	            returns_group = returns[traj_idx]
941	            w_cumulative_group = w_cumulative[traj_idx]
942	            mask_group = response_mask[traj_idx]
943	
944	            # Compute per-timestep baseline: B_t = Σ[G_t × W_t] / Σ[W_t]
945	            # where W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t ||s_j||² (cumulative path variance)
946	            # Shape: [seq_len]
947	            numerator = (returns_group * w_cumulative_group * mask_group).sum(dim=0)  # Sum over trajectories
948	            denominator = (w_cumulative_group * mask_group).sum(dim=0) + epsilon
949	
950	            baseline_per_step = numerator / denominator  # [seq_len]
951	
952	            # Assign to all trajectories in this group
953	            baselines[traj_idx] = baseline_per_step.unsqueeze(0).expand(N, -1)
954	
955	            if handle_zero_tail:
956	                # Optionally zero out the portion of the longest trajectory that extends
957	                # beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
958	                response_lengths = mask_group.sum(dim=-1)
959	                sorted_lengths, _ = torch.sort(response_lengths)
960	                max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-1].item())
961	                second_max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-2].item())
962	                max_length_idx = (response_lengths == max_length).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
963	                if max_length_idx.numel() == 1 and max_length > second_max_length:
964	                    max_length_traj_idx = trajectory_indices[int(max_length_idx[0])]
965	                    baselines[max_length_traj_idx, second_max_length:] = 0.0
966	
967	        # Compute advantages: A_t = G_t - B_t
968	        advantages = (returns - baselines) * response_mask
969	
970	    return advantages, returns
971	
972	
973	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.TIR_OPTIMAL_TOKEN_BASELINE)
974	def compute_multi_turn_optimal_token_baseline_advantage(
975	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
976	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
977	    index: np.ndarray,
978	    old_log_probs: torch.Tensor,
979	    sum_pi_squared: torch.Tensor,
980	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor = None,
981	    handle_zero_tail: bool = True,
982	    epsilon: float = 1e-8,
983	    **kwargs,
984	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
985	    """
986	    Compute advantages using Optimal Token Baseline (OTB).
987	
988	    Unlike the group mean based baseline which uses a single baseline per trajectory,
989	    this computes a unique baseline for each timestep using cumulative path variance.
990	
991	    Theory:
992	        For each timestep t in each prompt group:
993	            B_t* = E[G_t × W_t] / E[W_t]
994	        where W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t ||s_j||² (cumulative path-variance proxy)
995	        and ||s_j||² = 1 - 2π_j + Σπ²
996	
997	    The cumulative sum W_t captures the "realized energy" of trajectory has been up to timestep t,
998	    giving higher weight to predicting rewards on high-variance paths.
999	
1000	    Args:
1001	        token_level_rewards: Rewards at each token position [shape: (bs, response_length)]
1002	        response_mask: Binary mask for valid tokens (1) vs padding (0) [shape: (bs, response_length)]
1003	        index: Prompt indices for grouping trajectories from same prompt [shape: (bs,)]
1004	        old_log_probs: Log probabilities from training policy during generation [shape: (bs, response_length)]
1005	        sum_pi_squared: Sum of squared probabilities over vocabulary Σπ² [shape: (bs, response_length)]
1006	        rollout_is_weights: Pre-computed IS weights for W correction [shape: (bs, response_length)],
1007	            None if not using IS
1008	        handle_zero_tail: If True, zero baselines will be set in the portion of the longest trajectory
1009	            that extends beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
1010	            Default: False
1011	        epsilon: Small constant for numerical stability (default: 1e-8)
1012	
1013	    Returns:
1014	        advantages: OTB advantage estimates [shape: (bs, response_length)]
1015	        returns: Cumulative rewards (returns) from each position [shape: (bs, response_length)]
1016	
1017	    Note on Rollout Importance Sampling:
1018	        When rollout_is_weights is provided, W_t is scaled by ρ̄²(t) to minimize MSE under truncated IS:
1019	            B_t* = Σ[G_t × ρ̄²(t) × W_t] / Σ[ρ̄²(t) × W_t]
1020	    """
1021	    with torch.no_grad():
1022	        # Compute returns (reward-to-go) for each timestep
1023	        token_returns = (token_level_rewards * response_mask).flip(dims=[-1]).cumsum(dim=-1).flip(dims=[-1])
1024	
1025	        # Step 1: Compute w_per_timestep = 1 - 2π_t + Σπ²)
1026	        pi_t = torch.exp(old_log_probs)
1027	        w_per_timestep = 1 - 2 * pi_t + sum_pi_squared
1028	
1029	        # Step 2: Apply rollout importance sampling correction (if enabled)
1030	        if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1031	            # Scale W by ρ̄² to minimize MSE under truncated IS
1032	            w_per_timestep = w_per_timestep * (rollout_is_weights**2)
1033	
1034	        # Step 3: Compute cumulative path-variance proxy: W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t w_j
1035	        # This measures accumulated variance from the start of the trajectory up to timestep t
1036	        w_cumulative = (w_per_timestep * response_mask).cumsum(dim=-1)
1037	
1038	        # Step 4: Concatenate returns and w_cumulative for each trajectory
1039	        # This allows us to compute baseline per timestep for each trajectory
1040	        response_lengths = response_mask.sum(dim=-1).to(dtype=torch.long)  # [shape: (bs * n, )]
1041	        max_response_length = int(response_lengths.max().item()) if response_lengths.numel() > 0 else 0
1042	        all_w_values = w_cumulative.new_zeros(
1043	            (len(response_lengths), max_response_length)
1044	        )  # [shape: (bs * n, max_response_length)]
1045	        all_returns = torch.zeros_like(all_w_values)
1046	        for i in range(len(response_lengths)):
1047	            length = int(response_lengths[i].item())
1048	            if length == 0:
1049	                continue
1050	            mask = response_mask[i].bool()
1051	            all_w_values[i, :length] = w_cumulative[i, mask]
1052	            all_returns[i, :length] = token_returns[i, mask]
1053	
1054	        # Group trajectories by prompt
1055	        prompt_groups = defaultdict(list)
1056	        for i in range(len(response_lengths)):
1057	            if response_lengths[i] == 0:
1058	                continue
1059	            prompt_groups[index[i]].append(i)
1060	
1061	        # Compute optimal baseline for each prompt group
1062	        baselines = torch.zeros_like(all_returns)
1063	
1064	        for _, trajectory_indices in prompt_groups.items():
1065	            N = len(trajectory_indices)
1066	            traj_idx = torch.tensor(trajectory_indices, device=all_returns.device)
1067	
1068	            if N == 1:
1069	                # Single trajectory - no baseline (keep original reward as advantage)
1070	                baselines[traj_idx[0]] = 0.0
1071	                continue
1072	
1073	            # Extract group data
1074	            w_group = all_w_values[traj_idx]  # [shape: (N, max_response_length)]
1075	            R_group = all_returns[traj_idx]  # [shape: (N, max_response_length)]
1076	            # Direct optimal baseline - single value for all in group
1077	            b_star = (R_group * w_group).sum(dim=0) / (w_group.sum(dim=0) + epsilon)
1078	            # Convert to match baselines dtype (epsilon can cause float64 promotion)
1079	            baselines[traj_idx] = b_star.to(baselines.dtype)
1080	
1081	            if handle_zero_tail:
1082	                # Optionally zero out the portion of the longest trajectory that extends
1083	                # beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
1084	                response_lengths_group = response_lengths[traj_idx]
1085	                sorted_lengths, _ = torch.sort(response_lengths_group)
1086	                max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-1].item())
1087	                second_max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-2].item())
1088	                max_length_idx = (response_lengths_group == max_length).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
1089	                if max_length_idx.numel() == 1 and max_length > second_max_length:
1090	                    max_length_traj_idx = trajectory_indices[int(max_length_idx[0])]
1091	                    baselines[max_length_traj_idx, second_max_length:] = 0.0
1092	
1093	        # Compute advantages
1094	        all_advantages = all_returns - baselines  # [shape: (bs * n, max_response_length)]
1095	
1096	        advantages = torch.zeros_like(token_returns)  # [shape: (bs * n, turn * response_length)]
1097	        for i in range(len(response_lengths)):
1098	            if response_lengths[i] == 0:
1099	                continue
1100	            advantages[i, response_mask[i].bool()] = all_advantages[i, : response_lengths[i]]
1101	
1102	        advantages = advantages * response_mask  # [shape: (bs * n * turn, response_length)]
1103	
1104	    return advantages, token_returns

1107	def compute_rewards(token_level_scores, old_log_prob, ref_log_prob, kl_ratio):
1108	    """Compute token-level rewards with KL penalty.
1109	
1110	    Args:
1111	        token_level_scores (torch.Tensor): Token-level reward scores.
1112	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor): Log probabilities from current policy.
1113	        ref_log_prob (torch.Tensor): Log probabilities from reference policy.
1114	        kl_ratio (float): KL penalty coefficient.
1115	
1116	    Returns:
1117	        torch.Tensor: Token-level rewards with KL penalty applied.
1118	    """
1119	    kl = old_log_prob - ref_log_prob
1120	    return token_level_scores - kl * kl_ratio

1123	def agg_loss(
1124	    loss_mat: torch.Tensor,
1125	    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,
1126	    loss_agg_mode: str,
1127	    dp_size: int = 1,
1128	    batch_num_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
1129	    global_batch_size: Optional[int] = None,
1130	    loss_scale_factor: Optional[int] = None,
1131	):
1132	    """
1133	    Aggregate the loss across global batch to ensure the loss is invariant to fsdp/megatron parallelism.
1134	
1135	    NOTE: The returned loss has different behaviors for different backend:
1136	    - FSDP: the loss is directly used for backward.
1137	    - Megatron: the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` and `cp_size` for pp schedule.
1138	
1139	    Args:
1140	        loss_mat: micro batch loss matrix, (bs, response_length)
1141	        loss_mask: micro batch loss mask, (bs, response_length)
1142	        loss_agg_mode: method to aggregate the loss matrix into a scalar
1143	        dp_size: data parallel size
1144	        batch_num_tokens: number of valid tokens in global batch
1145	        global_batch_size: global batch size
1146	        loss_scale_factor: scale factor for "seq-mean-token-sum-norm" mode. If None, uses loss_mask.shape[-1].
1147	            Set this to a constant value to ensure consistent normalization throughout training.
1148	
1149	    Returns:
1150	        loss: `a scalar torch.Tensor`
1151	            aggregated loss
1152	    """
1153	    if loss_agg_mode == "token-mean":
1154	        if batch_num_tokens is None:
1155	            if dp_size > 1:
1156	                raise ValueError("(global) batch_num_tokens is required when dp_size > 1")
1157	            batch_num_tokens = loss_mask.sum()
1158	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(loss_mat, loss_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
1159	    elif loss_agg_mode in ["seq-mean-token-sum", "seq-mean-token-sum-norm"]:
1160	        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1)  # token-sum
1161	        seq_mask = (torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1) > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
1162	        if global_batch_size is None:
1163	            if dp_size > 1:
1164	                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")
1165	            global_batch_size = seq_mask.sum()
1166	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean
1167	        if loss_agg_mode == "seq-mean-token-sum-norm":
1168	            if loss_scale_factor is None:
1169	                horizon = loss_mask.shape[-1]
1170	                loss_scale_factor = horizon
1171	            loss /= loss_scale_factor
1172	    elif loss_agg_mode == "seq-mean-token-mean":
1173	        seq_mask = torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1)  # per-sequence token count
1174	        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1) / (seq_mask + 1e-8)  # token-mean
1175	        seq_mask = (seq_mask > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
1176	        if global_batch_size is None:
1177	            if dp_size > 1:
1178	                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")
1179	            global_batch_size = seq_mask.sum()
1180	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean
1181	    else:
1182	        raise ValueError(f"Invalid loss_agg_mode: {loss_agg_mode}")
1183	
1184	    return loss

1188	def compute_policy_loss(
1189	    old_log_prob,
1190	    log_prob,
1191	    advantages,
1192	    response_mask,
1193	    cliprange=None,
1194	    cliprange_low=None,
1195	    cliprange_high=None,
1196	    clip_ratio_c=3.0,
1197	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1198	):
1199	    """
1200	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for PPO.
1201	
1202	    Adapted from
1203	    https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py#L1122
1204	
1205	    Args:
1206	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1207	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1208	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1209	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1210	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1211	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1212	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1213	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1214	        cliprange (float, optional):
1215	            Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
1216	            Defaults to None (must be provided).
1217	        cliprange_low (float, optional):
1218	            Lower clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1219	        cliprange_high (float, optional):
1220	            Upper clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1221	        clip_ratio_c (float, optional):
1222	            Lower bound of the ratio for dual-clip PPO. See https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.09729.
1223	            Defaults to 3.0.
1224	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1225	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1226	    """
1227	    assert clip_ratio_c > 1.0, (
1228	        "The lower bound of the clip_ratio_c for dual-clip PPO should be greater than 1.0,"
1229	        + f" but get the value: {clip_ratio_c}."
1230	    )
1231	
1232	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1233	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1234	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1235	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1236	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1237	
1238	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
1239	    if cliprange_low is None:
1240	        cliprange_low = cliprange
1241	    if cliprange_high is None:
1242	        cliprange_high = cliprange
1243	    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(
1244	        ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high
1245	    )  # - clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A
1246	    clip_pg_losses1 = torch.maximum(
1247	        pg_losses1, pg_losses2
1248	    )  # max(-ratio * A, -clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A)
1249	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean(torch.gt(pg_losses2, pg_losses1).float(), response_mask)
1250	
1251	    pg_losses3 = -advantages * clip_ratio_c
1252	    clip_pg_losses2 = torch.min(pg_losses3, clip_pg_losses1)
1253	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean(
1254	        torch.gt(clip_pg_losses1, pg_losses3) * (advantages < 0).float(), response_mask
1255	    )
1256	
1257	    pg_losses = torch.where(advantages < 0, clip_pg_losses2, clip_pg_losses1)
1258	    pg_loss = agg_loss(loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode)
1259	
1260	    return pg_loss, pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower

1305	    cliprange = clip_ratio
1306	    cliprange_low = clip_ratio_low

1308

1323	    if cliprange_high is None:
1324	        cliprange_high = cliprange

1357	@register_policy_loss("dppo_tv")
1358	def compute_policy_loss_dppo_tv(
1359	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1360	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1361	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1362	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1363	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1364	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1365	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1366	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1367	    """
1368	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for DPPO-Binary-TV.
1369	
1370	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1371	
1372	    Args:
1373	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1374	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1375	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1376	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1377	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1378	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1379	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1380	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1381	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1382	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1383	        config: `(verl.trainer.config.ActorConfig)`:
1384	            config for the actor.
1385	        rollout_log_probs: `(torch.Tensor)`:
1386	            log probabilities of actions under the rollout policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1387	    """
1388	
1389	    assert config is not None
1390	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
1391	    # Note: the clip_ratio is different from the standard PPO, it is the TV divergence threshold for DPPO.
1392	    clip_divergence = config.clip_ratio
1393	    clip_divergence_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_divergence
1394	    clip_divergence_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_divergence
1395	
1396	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1397	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1398	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1399	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1400	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1401	
1402	    # Instead of dual-clip PPO, we use truncated importance sampling (TIS) to clip the policy loss.
1403	    # However, a large threshold is recommended to avoid performance degradation due to the truncation bias.
1404	    # See Section 5.4 in https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1405	    clip_ratio_c = config.get("clip_ratio_c", 20.0)
1406	    truncated_ratio = torch.clamp(ratio, max=clip_ratio_c)
1407	    truncated_ratio = truncated_ratio.detach()
1408	
1409	    # Compute valid mask for DPPO-Binary-TV
1410	    prob = torch.exp(log_prob)
1411	    old_prob = torch.exp(old_log_prob)
1412	    valid_positive_mask = (prob - old_prob) <= clip_divergence_high
1413	    valid_negative_mask = (prob - old_prob) >= -clip_divergence_low
1414	    valid_mask = torch.where(advantages > 0, valid_positive_mask, valid_negative_mask)
1415	    valid_mask = valid_mask.detach().float()
1416	
1417	    pg_losses = -advantages * truncated_ratio * log_prob * valid_mask
1418	
1419	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1420	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1421	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1422	
1423	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1424	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
1425	    )
1426	
1427	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((1.0 - valid_mask).float(), response_mask)
1428	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean((ratio > clip_ratio_c).float() * valid_mask, response_mask)
1429	
1430	    pg_metrics = {
1431	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1432	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1433	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1434	    }

1438	@register_policy_loss("dppo_kl")
1439	def compute_policy_loss_dppo_kl(
1440	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1441	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1442	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1443	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1444	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1445	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1446	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1447	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1448	    """
1449	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for DPPO-Binary-KL.
1450	
1451	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1452	
1453	    Args:
1454	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1455	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1456	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1457	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1458	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1459	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1460	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1461	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1462	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1463	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1464	        config: `(verl.trainer.config.ActorConfig)`:
1465	            config for the actor.
1466	        rollout_log_probs: `(torch.Tensor)`:
1467	            log probabilities of actions under the rollout policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1468	    """
1469	
1470	    assert config is not None
1471	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
1472	    # Note: the clip_ratio is different from the standard PPO, it is the KL divergence threshold for DPPO.
1473	    clip_divergence = config.clip_ratio
1474	    clip_divergence_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_divergence
1475	    clip_divergence_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_divergence
1476	
1477	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1478	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1479	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1480	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1481	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1482	
1483	    # Instead of dual-clip PPO, we use truncated importance sampling (TIS) to clip the policy loss.
1484	    # However, a large threshold is recommended to avoid performance degradation due to the truncation bias.
1485	    # See Section 5.4 in https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1486	    clip_ratio_c = config.get("clip_ratio_c", 20.0)
1487	    truncated_ratio = torch.clamp(ratio, max=clip_ratio_c)
1488	    truncated_ratio = truncated_ratio.detach()
1489	
1490	    # Compute valid mask for DPPO-Binary-KL
1491	    prob = torch.exp(log_prob)
1492	    old_prob = torch.exp(old_log_prob)
1493	    binary_kl = old_prob * (old_log_prob - log_prob) + (1 - old_prob) * torch.log(
1494	        (1.0 - old_prob + 1e-8) / (1.0 - prob + 1e-8)
1495	    )
1496	    valid_positive_mask = (binary_kl <= clip_divergence_high) | (prob <= old_prob)
1497	    valid_negative_mask = (binary_kl <= clip_divergence_low) | (prob >= old_prob)
1498	    valid_mask = torch.where(advantages > 0, valid_positive_mask, valid_negative_mask)
1499	    valid_mask = valid_mask.detach().float()
1500	
1501	    pg_losses = -advantages * truncated_ratio * log_prob * valid_mask
1502	
1503	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1504	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1505	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1506	
1507	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1508	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
1509	    )
1510	
1511	    # For compatibility, return zero for pg_clipfrac_lower (not used in standard DPPO)
1512	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((1.0 - valid_mask).float(), response_mask)
1513	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean((ratio > clip_ratio_c).float() * valid_mask, response_mask)
1514	
1515	    pg_metrics = {
1516	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1517	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1518	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1519	    }
1520	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

1523	@register_policy_loss("gspo")
1524	def compute_policy_loss_gspo(
1525	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1526	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1527	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1528	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1529	    loss_agg_mode: str = "seq-mean-token-mean",
1530	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1531	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1532	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1533	    """
1534	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for GSPO.
1535	
1536	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.18071 for more details.
1537	
1538	    Args:
1539	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1540	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1541	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1542	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1543	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1544	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1545	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1546	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1547	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1548	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. For GSPO, it is recommended to use "seq-mean-token-mean".
1549	    """
1550	
1551	    assert config is not None
1552	    assert isinstance(config, ActorConfig)
1553	    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else config.clip_ratio
1554	    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else config.clip_ratio
1555	
1556	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1557	
1558	    # compute sequence-level importance ratio:
1559	    # si(θ) = (π_θ(yi|x)/π_θold(yi|x))^(1/|yi|) =
1560	    # exp [(1/|y_i|) * Σ_t log(π_θ(y_i,t|x,y_i,<t)/π_θold(y_i,t|x,y_i,<t))]
1561	    seq_lengths = torch.sum(response_mask, dim=-1).clamp(min=1)
1562	    negative_approx_kl_seq = torch.sum(negative_approx_kl * response_mask, dim=-1) / seq_lengths
1563	
1564	    # Combined ratio at token level:
1565	    # s_i,t(θ) = sg[s_i(θ)] · π_θ(y_i,t|x, y_i,<t) / sg[π_θ(y_i,t|x, y_i,<t)]
1566	    # In log space: log(s_i,t(θ)) = sg[log(s_i(θ))] + log_prob - sg[log_prob]
1567	    log_seq_importance_ratio = log_prob - log_prob.detach() + negative_approx_kl_seq.detach().unsqueeze(-1)
1568	    log_seq_importance_ratio = torch.clamp(log_seq_importance_ratio, max=10.0)  # clamp for numerical stability
1569	
1570	    # finaly exp() to remove log
1571	    seq_importance_ratio = torch.exp(log_seq_importance_ratio)
1572	
1573	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * seq_importance_ratio
1574	    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(seq_importance_ratio, 1 - clip_ratio_low, 1 + clip_ratio_high)
1575	    pg_losses = torch.maximum(pg_losses1, pg_losses2)
1576	
1577	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1578	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1579	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1580	
1581	    # for GSPO, we need to aggregate the loss at the sequence level (seq-mean-token-mean)
1582	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1583	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode="seq-mean-token-mean", **config.global_batch_info
1584	    )
1585	
1586	    # For compatibility, return zero for pg_clipfrac_lower (not used in standard GSPO)
1587	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean(torch.gt(pg_losses2, pg_losses1).float(), response_mask)
1588	    pg_clipfrac_lower = torch.tensor(0.0, device=pg_loss.device)
1589	
1590	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1591	    pg_metrics = {
1592	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1593	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1594	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1595	    }
1596	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

1600	def compute_policy_loss_sapo(
1601	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1602	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1603	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1604	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1605	    loss_agg_mode: str = "seq-mean-token-mean",
1606	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1607	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1608	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1609	    """
1610	    Compute the smoothed policy objective and related metrics for SAPO.
1611	
1612	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.20347 for more details.
1613	
1614	    Args:
1615	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1616	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1617	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1618	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1619	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1620	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1621	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1622	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1623	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1624	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. For SAPO, it is recommended to use "seq-mean-token-mean".
1625	    """
1626	
1627	    assert config is not None
1628	    assert isinstance(config, ActorConfig)
1629	
1630	    # temperature for positive and negative token updates
1631	    tau_pos = torch.as_tensor(config.tau_pos, dtype=advantages.dtype, device=advantages.device)
1632	    tau_neg = torch.as_tensor(config.tau_neg, dtype=advantages.dtype, device=advantages.device)
1633	
1634	    def gate_function(x, tau):
1635	        """The gating function used in SAPO"""
1636	        return torch.sigmoid(tau * (x - 1.0)) * (4.0 / tau)
1637	
1638	    # compute IS at token level:
1639	    # r_{i,t}(θ) = π_θ(y_{i,t}|x, y_{i,<t}) / π_θold(y_{i,t}|x, y_{i,<t})]
1640	    # In log space: log(r_{i,t}(θ)) = log_prob - ol_log_prob
1641	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1642	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1643	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1644	    # finally exp() to remove log and get r_{i,t}(θ)
1645	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1646	
1647	    # tau_{i,t} is tau_pos if adv > 0 else tau_neg
1648	    taus = torch.where(
1649	        condition=advantages > 0,
1650	        input=tau_pos,  # if A_{i,t} > 0 we set to tau_pos
1651	        other=tau_neg,  # if A_{i,t} <= 0 we set to tau_neg
1652	    )
1653	
1654	    # compute the gates f_{i,t}(r_{i,t}(θ)) at token level
1655	    gates = gate_function(ratio, taus)
1656	
1657	    # compute policy gradient loss
1658	    pg_losses = -gates * advantages
1659	
1660	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1661	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1662	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1663	
1664	    # for SAPO, we need to aggregate the loss at the sequence level (seq-mean-token-mean)
1665	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1666	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode="seq-mean-token-mean", **config.global_batch_info
1667	    )
1668	
1669	    # For compatibility, return zero for both pg_clipfrac and pg_clipfrac_lower (not used in SAPO)
1670	    pg_clipfrac = torch.tensor(0.0, device=pg_loss.device)
1671	    pg_clipfrac_lower = torch.tensor(0.0, device=pg_loss.device)
1672	    # compute KL for metrics tracking
1673	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1674	    # return metrics dict
1675	    pg_metrics = {
1676	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1677	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1678	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1679	    }
1680	
1681	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics
1682

1720	@register_policy_loss("clip_cov")
1721	def compute_policy_loss_clip_cov(
1722	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1723	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1724	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1725	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1726	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1727	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1728	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1729	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1730	    """
1731	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for Clip-Cov.
1732	
1733	    Adapted from
1734	    https://github.com/PRIME-RL/Entropy-Mechanism-of-RL/blob/main/verl/trainer/ppo/core_algos.py
1735	
1736	    Args:
1737	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1738	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1739	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1740	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1741	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1742	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1743	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1744	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1745	        cliprange (float, optional):
1746	            Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
1747	            Defaults to None (must be provided).
1748	        cliprange_low (float, optional):
1749	            Lower clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1750	        cliprange_high (float, optional):
1751	            Upper clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1752	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1753	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1754	        clip_cvo_ratio (float, optional):
1755	            Ratio for clipping the covariance. Defaults to 0.0002.
1756	        clip_cov_lb (float, optional):
1757	            Lower bound for clipping covariance. Defaults to 1.0.
1758	        clip_cov_ub (float, optional):
1759	            Upper bound for clipping covariance. Defaults to 5.0.
1760	    """
1761	    assert config is not None
1762	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig), "passing AlgoConfig not supported yet"
1763	    assert config.policy_loss is not None
1764	
1765	    clip_cov_ratio = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ratio if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ratio is not None else 0.0002
1766	    cliprange = config.clip_ratio
1767	    cliprange_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else cliprange
1768	    cliprange_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else cliprange
1769	    clip_cov_ub = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ub if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ub is not None else 5.0
1770	    clip_cov_lb = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_lb if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_lb is not None else 1.0
1771	
1772	    assert clip_cov_ratio > 0, "clip_ratio should be larger than 0."
1773	
1774	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1775	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1776	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1777	
1778	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
1779	
1780	    if cliprange_low is None:
1781	        cliprange_low = cliprange
1782	    if cliprange_high is None:
1783	        cliprange_high = cliprange
1784	
1785	    corr = torch.ones_like(advantages)
1786	    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high)
1787	    clip_by_origin = (pg_losses2 > pg_losses1) & (response_mask > 0)
1788	
1789	    cov_all = (advantages - verl_F.masked_mean(advantages, response_mask)) * (
1790	        log_prob - verl_F.masked_mean(log_prob.detach(), response_mask)
1791	    )
1792	    cov_all[response_mask == 0] = -torch.inf
1793	    cov_all[clip_by_origin] = -torch.inf
1794	
1795	    clip_num = max(int(clip_cov_ratio * response_mask.sum().item()), 1)
1796	    top_k_idx = (cov_all < clip_cov_ub) & (cov_all > clip_cov_lb) & (response_mask > 0)
1797	    top_k_idx = torch.nonzero(top_k_idx)
1798	
1799	    if len(top_k_idx) > 0:
1800	        perm = torch.randperm(len(top_k_idx))
1801	        top_k_idx = top_k_idx[perm[: min(clip_num, len(top_k_idx))]]
1802	    else:
1803	        top_k_idx = torch.empty((0, 2), device=cov_all.device, dtype=torch.long)
1804	
1805	    corr[top_k_idx[:, 0], top_k_idx[:, 1]] = 0
1806	
1807	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((corr == 0).float(), response_mask)
1808	
1809	    pg_losses = torch.maximum(pg_losses1, pg_losses2) * corr
1810	
1811	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1812	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1813	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1814	
1815	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1816	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
1817	    )
1818	    pg_metrics = {
1819	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1820	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1821	    }
1822	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics
1823

1826	def compute_policy_loss_kl_cov(
1827	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1828	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1829	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1830	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1831	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1832	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1833	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1834	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1835	    """
1836	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for Clip-Cov.
1837	
1838	    Adapted from
1839	    https://github.com/PRIME-RL/Entropy-Mechanism-of-RL/blob/main/verl/trainer/ppo/core_algos.py
1840	
1841	    Args:
1842	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1843	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1844	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1845	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1846	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1847	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1848	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1849	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1850	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1851	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1852	        kl_cov_ratio (float, optional):
1853	            Ratio for selecting the top-k covariance values. Defaults to 0.0002.
1854	        ppo_kl_coef (float, optional):
1855	            Coefficient for the KL penalty term in the loss. Defaults to 1.
1856	    """
1857	    assert config is not None
1858	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig), "passing AlgoConfig not supported yet"
1859	    assert config.policy_loss is not None
1860	
1861	    kl_cov_ratio = config.policy_loss.kl_cov_ratio if config.policy_loss.kl_cov_ratio is not None else 0.0002
1862	    ppo_kl_coef = config.policy_loss.ppo_kl_coef if config.policy_loss.ppo_kl_coef is not None else 1.0
1863	
1864	    assert kl_cov_ratio > 0, "kl_cov_ratio should be larger than 0."
1865	
1866	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1867	    abs_kl = negative_approx_kl.abs()
1868	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1869	    ppo_kl_abs = verl_F.masked_mean(negative_approx_kl.abs(), response_mask)
1870	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
1871	    pg_losses_kl = -advantages * ratio + ppo_kl_coef * abs_kl
1872	    pg_losses = pg_losses1
1873	
1874	    all_valid = response_mask > 0

1906	def compute_policy_loss_geo_mean(
1907	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1908	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1909	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1910	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1911	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1912	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1913	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1914	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1915	    """
1916	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for GMPO.
1917	
1918	    Adapted from paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.20673
1919	    https://github.com/callsys/GMPO/blob/main/train_zero_math_gmpo.py
1920	
1921	    Args:
1922	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1923	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1924	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1925	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1926	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1927	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1928	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1929	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1930	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1931	            not used
1932	    """
1933	
1934	    assert config is not None
1935	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
1936	    clip_ratio = config.clip_ratio  # Clipping parameter. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
1937	    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_ratio
1938	    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_ratio
1939	
1940	    cliprange = clip_ratio
1941	    cliprange_low = clip_ratio_low
1942	    cliprange_high = clip_ratio_high
1943	    if cliprange_low is None:
1944	        cliprange_low = cliprange
1945	    if cliprange_high is None:
1946	        cliprange_high = cliprange
1947	
1948	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1949	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability (uncomment it if you like)
1950	    # negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1951	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1952	
1953	    # Clipping at token-level & Clipping wider
1954	    sgn_advantage = torch.sign(advantages)
1955	    negative_approx_kl_clamp = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, -cliprange_low, cliprange_high)
1956	    negative_approx_kl_min = torch.min(sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl, sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl_clamp)
1957	    negative_approx_kl_min = sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl_min
1958	
1959	    # Geometric-Mean Policy Optimization
1960	    response_mask_sum = response_mask.sum(dim=-1)
1961	    ratio = torch.exp((negative_approx_kl_min * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8))

1963	    # otherwise, below would be not consistent with the paper
1964	    advantage = (advantages * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8)

1966	
1967	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1968	    # For geo_mean, IS weights are 2D (batch_size, seq_length) and need to be aggregated to sequence level
1969	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1970	        # Aggregate token-level weights to sequence level using geometric mean for consistency
1971	        # Note: rollout_is_weights is always 2D regardless of aggregation mode
1972	        seq_is_weights = torch.exp(
1973	            (torch.log(rollout_is_weights + 1e-10) * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8)
1974	        )
1975	        pg_losses = pg_losses * seq_is_weights
1976	
1977	    pg_loss = torch.mean(pg_losses)
1978	
1979	    # higher: ratio is too large that need clamp to clip_high (when adv > 0)
1980	    clipped = torch.ne(negative_approx_kl, negative_approx_kl_clamp)
1981	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((clipped * (advantages > 0)).float(), response_mask)
1982	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean((clipped * (advantages < 0)).float(), response_mask)

1984	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1985	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1986	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1987	    }
1988	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

1992	def compute_policy_loss_cispo(
1993	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1994	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1995	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1996	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1997	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1998	    config: Optional[DictConfig | ActorConfig] = None,
1999	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
2000	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
2001	    """
2002	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for CISPO.
2003	
2004	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.13585 for more details.
2005	    """
2006	
2007	    assert config is not None
2008	    assert isinstance(config, ActorConfig)
2009	    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else config.clip_ratio
2010	    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else config.clip_ratio
2011	
2012	    # Compute importance sampling ratio: π_θ / π_θ_old
2013	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
2014	    # Clamp for numerical stability
2015	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
2016	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
2017	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
2018	
2019	    # CISPO: Clip the importance sampling weights
2020	    # KEY: Apply stop gradient to the clipped ratio
2021	    # This prevents gradients from flowing through the ratio computation and clipping
2022	    # Gradients only flow through log_prob in the final loss term
2023	    clipped_ratio = torch.clamp(ratio, 1 - clip_ratio_low, 1 + clip_ratio_high)
2024	    clipped_ratio_sg = clipped_ratio.detach()
2025	
2026	    # CISPO objective function (to maximize): J = sg(clip(ratio)) * A * log π_θ
2027	    # Loss function (to minimize): L = -J = -sg(clip(ratio)) * A * log_prob
2028	    pg_losses = -clipped_ratio_sg * advantages * log_prob
2029	
2030	    # Track clipping statistics
2031	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((ratio != clipped_ratio).float(), response_mask)
2032	
2033	    # Apply rollout importance sampling weights if provided
2034	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
2035	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
2036	
2037	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
2038	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
2039	    )
2040	
2041	    # For compatibility, return zero for pg_clipfrac_lower (not used in CISPO)
2042	    pg_clipfrac_lower = torch.tensor(0.0, device=pg_loss.device)
2043	
2044	    pg_metrics = {
2045	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
2046	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
2047	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
2048	    }
2049	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

153	class AdaptiveKLController:
154	    """
155	    Adaptive KL controller described in the paper:
156	    https://arxiv.org/pdf/1909.08593.pdf
157	    """
158	
159	    def __init__(self, init_kl_coef, target_kl, horizon):
160	        self.value = init_kl_coef
161	        self.target = target_kl
162	        self.horizon = horizon
163	
164	    def update(self, current_kl, n_steps):
165	        """Update the KL coefficient based on current KL divergence.
166	
167	        Args:
168	            current_kl (float): Current KL divergence value.
169	            n_steps (int): Number of steps taken.
170	        """
171	        target = self.target
172	        proportional_error = np.clip(current_kl / target - 1, -0.2, 0.2)
173	        mult = 1 + proportional_error * n_steps / self.horizon
174	        self.value *= mult

216	def compute_gae_advantage_return(
217	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
218	    values: torch.Tensor,
219	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
220	    gamma: torch.Tensor,
221	    lam: torch.Tensor,
222	):
223	    """Adapted from https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py
224	
225	    Args:
226	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
227	            shape is (bs, response_length)
228	        values: `(torch.Tensor)`
229	            shape is (bs, response_length)
230	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
231	            shape is (bs, response_length). [EOS] mask. The token after [EOS] have mask zero.
232	        gamma is `(float)`
233	            discounted factor used in RL
234	        lam: `(float)`
235	            lambda value when computing Generalized Advantage Estimation (https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02438)
236	
237	    Returns:
238	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
239	            shape: (bs, response_length)
240	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
241	            shape: (bs, response_length)
242	
243	    """
244	    with torch.no_grad():
245	        nextvalues = 0
246	        lastgaelam = 0
247	        advantages_reversed = []
248	        gen_len = token_level_rewards.shape[-1]
249	
250	        for t in reversed(range(gen_len)):
251	            delta = token_level_rewards[:, t] + gamma * nextvalues - values[:, t]
252	            lastgaelam_ = delta + gamma * lam * lastgaelam
253	
254	            # skip values and TD-error on observation tokens
255	            nextvalues = values[:, t] * response_mask[:, t] + (1 - response_mask[:, t]) * nextvalues
256	            lastgaelam = lastgaelam_ * response_mask[:, t] + (1 - response_mask[:, t]) * lastgaelam
257	
258	            advantages_reversed.append(lastgaelam)
259	        advantages = torch.stack(advantages_reversed[::-1], dim=1)
260	
261	        returns = advantages + values
262	        advantages = verl_F.masked_whiten(advantages, response_mask)
263	    return advantages, returns

268	def compute_grpo_outcome_advantage(
269	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
270	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
271	    index: np.ndarray,
272	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
273	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
274	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
275	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
276	    """
277	    Compute advantage for GRPO, operating only on Outcome reward
278	    (with only one scalar reward for each response).
279	
280	    Args:
281	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
282	            shape is (bs, response_length)
283	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
284	            shape is (bs, response_length)
285	        index: `(np.ndarray)`
286	            index array for grouping
287	        epsilon: `(float)`
288	            small value to avoid division by zero
289	        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: `(bool)`
290	            whether to scale the GRPO advantage
291	        config: `(Optional[AlgoConfig])`
292	            algorithm configuration object
293	
294	    Note:
295	        If norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo is True, the advantage is scaled by the std, as in the original GRPO.
296	        If False, the advantage is not scaled, as in Dr.GRPO (https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783).
297	
298	    Returns:
299	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
300	            shape is (bs, response_length)
301	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
302	            shape is (bs, response_length)
303	    """
304	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
305	
306	    with torch.no_grad():
307	        group_ids = as_torch_index(index, device=scores.device)
308	        scores = verl_F.grouped_whiten(
309	            scores,
310	            group_ids,
311	            eps=epsilon,
312	            scale_by_std=norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo,
313	        )
314	        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
315	
316	    return scores, scores

320	def compute_grpo_vectorized_outcome_advantage(
321	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
322	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
323	    index: np.ndarray,
324	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
325	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
326	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
327	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
328	    """
329	    Vectorized GRPO（outcome-only）:
330	      For each group g:
331	      a_i = \\frac{r_i - \\mu_g}{\\sigma_g} (or without dividing by \\sigma_g),
332	      then broadcast the scalar across the token dimension (multiplied by response_mask).。
333	    """
334	    with torch.no_grad():
335	        scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
336	        g = as_torch_index(index, device=scores.device)
337	        mean_g, std_g, _ = group_mean_std(scores, g, eps=epsilon, device=scores.device)
338	        if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
339	            scalars = (scores - mean_g[g]) / (std_g[g] + epsilon)
340	        else:
341	            scalars = scores - mean_g[g]
342	        advantages = scalars.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
343	        return advantages, advantages

346	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GDPO)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("gdpo")
347	def compute_gdpo_outcome_advantage(
348	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
349	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
350	    index: np.ndarray,
351	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
352	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
353	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
354	    non_tensor_batch: Optional[dict] = None,
355	    batch: Optional[dict] = None,
356	    **kwargs,
357	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
358	    """
359	    GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization.
360	
361	    Instead of summing all reward dimensions first (like GRPO), GDPO normalizes
362	    each reward dimension independently within each group before aggregation.
363	    This prevents a dominant reward signal from drowning out weaker ones.
364	
365	    Mathematical formulation:
366	        Step 1 – Group-wise decoupled normalization (via GRPO per dimension):
367	            For each reward dimension k, within each group g:
368	            A_k = (r_k - μ_group(r_k)) / (σ_group(r_k) + ε)
369	
370	        Step 2 – Weighted aggregation:
371	            A_sum = Σ_k w_k · A_k
372	
373	        Step 3 – Batch-level normalization (via masked_whiten):
374	            A_final = whiten(A_sum, response_mask)
375	
376	    Args:
377	        token_level_rewards: (bs, response_length) – standard token-level rewards.
378	            Used as fallback when per-dimension rewards are not provided.
379	        response_mask: (bs, response_length)
380	        index: (bs,) – group id per sample (from ``uid``).
381	        epsilon: Numerical stability constant.
382	        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: Whether to normalize by std in GRPO.
383	        config: Algorithm configuration (optional).
384	        non_tensor_batch: Non-tensor batch data containing per-dimension reward scores.
385	        batch: Batch data containing prompts, attention_mask, etc.
386	
387	    Note:
388	        Ref GDPO (https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242).
389	
390	    Returns:
391	        advantages: (bs, response_length)
392	        returns: (bs, response_length) – same as advantages (outcome-only).
393	    """
394	    score_list = None
395	    reward_weights = None
396	
397	    if config is not None and non_tensor_batch is not None and batch is not None:
398	        gdpo_reward_keys = config.get("gdpo_reward_keys", None)
399	        assert gdpo_reward_keys, (
400	            "GDPO requires 'algorithm.gdpo_reward_keys' listing the individual reward "
401	            "component keys returned by compute_score (e.g. ['format_reward', 'accuracy_reward'])."
402	        )
403	        device = token_level_rewards.device
404	        prompt_length = batch["prompts"].size(1)
405	        valid_response_length = batch["attention_mask"][:, prompt_length:].sum(dim=1) - 1
406	
407	        score_list = []
408	        for key in gdpo_reward_keys:
409	            assert key in non_tensor_batch, (
410	                f"GDPO reward key '{key}' not found in non_tensor_batch. "
411	                f"Available keys: {list(non_tensor_batch.keys())}. "
412	                f"Make sure your compute_score returns a dict containing '{key}'."
413	            )
414	            comp = non_tensor_batch[key]
415	            rm_score = torch.tensor(np.asarray(comp, dtype=np.float32), device=device)
416	            rm_scores = torch.zeros_like(response_mask, dtype=torch.float32)
417	            rm_scores[torch.arange(rm_scores.size(0), device=device), valid_response_length] = rm_score
418	            score_list.append(rm_scores)
419	
420	        gdpo_weights = config.get("gdpo_reward_weights", None)
421	        if gdpo_weights is not None:
422	            reward_weights = list(gdpo_weights)
423	
424	    if score_list is None:
425	        score_list = [token_level_rewards]
426	
427	    num_scores = len(score_list)
428	
429	    if reward_weights is not None:
430	        weights = torch.tensor(reward_weights, dtype=torch.float32, device=token_level_rewards.device)
431	    else:
432	        weights = torch.ones(num_scores, dtype=torch.float32, device=token_level_rewards.device)
433	
434	    new_advantage = None
435	
436	    for i in range(num_scores):
437	        normalized_score, _ = compute_grpo_outcome_advantage(
438	            token_level_rewards=score_list[i],
439	            response_mask=response_mask,
440	            index=index,
441	            epsilon=epsilon,
442	            norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo=norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo,
443	            config=config,
444	        )
445	
446	        if new_advantage is None:
447	            new_advantage = weights[i] * normalized_score
448	        else:
449	            new_advantage += weights[i] * normalized_score
450	
451	    advantages = verl_F.masked_whiten(new_advantage, response_mask) * response_mask
452	
453	    return advantages, advantages

461	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
462	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
463	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
464	    **kwargs,
465	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
466	    """
467	    Compute advantage for Pass@k using a GRPO-style outcome reward formulation.
468	    Only the best response per group gets a non-zero advantage: r_max - r_second_max.
469	
470	    Implemented as described in https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.19595.
471	
472	    Args:
473	        token_level_rewards: (bs, response_length)
474	        response_mask: (bs, response_length)
475	        index: (bs,) → group ID per sample
476	        epsilon: float for numerical stability
477	        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm settings, which contains "norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo"
478	
479	    Returns:
480	        advantages: (bs, response_length)
481	        returns: (bs, response_length)
482	    """
483	    assert config is not None
484	    # if True, normalize advantage by std within group
485	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo = config.get("norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo", True)
486	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)  # (bs,)
487	    advantages = torch.zeros_like(scores)
488	
489	    id2scores = defaultdict(list)
490	    id2indices = defaultdict(list)
491	
492	    with torch.no_grad():
493	        bsz = scores.shape[0]
494	        for i in range(bsz):
495	            idx = index[i]
496	            id2scores[idx].append(scores[i])
497	            id2indices[idx].append(i)
498	
499	        for idx in id2scores:
500	            rewards = torch.stack(id2scores[idx])  # (k,)
501	            if rewards.numel() < 2:
502	                raise ValueError(
503	                    f"Pass@k requires at least 2 samples per group. Got {rewards.numel()} for group {idx}."
504	                )
505	            topk, topk_idx = torch.topk(rewards, 2)
506	            r_max, r_second_max = topk[0], topk[1]
507	            i_max = id2indices[idx][topk_idx[0].item()]
508	            advantage = r_max - r_second_max
509	            if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
510	                std = torch.std(rewards)
511	                advantage = advantage / (std + epsilon)
512	            advantages[i_max] = advantage
513	
514	    advantages = advantages.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
515	    return advantages, advantages
516

583	
584	    Args:
585	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
586	            shape: (bs, response_length)
587	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
588	            shape: (bs, response_length)

590	
591	    Returns:
592	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
593	            shape: (bs, response_length)
594	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
595	            shape: (bs, response_length)
596	    """
597	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
598	
599	    id2score = defaultdict(list)
600	    id2mean = {}
601	
602	    with torch.no_grad():
603	        bsz = scores.shape[0]
604	        for i in range(bsz):
605	            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
606	        for idx in id2score:
607	            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
608	                id2mean[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
609	            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
610	                id2mean[idx] = torch.mean(torch.stack(id2score[idx]))
611	            else:
612	                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
613	        for i in range(bsz):
614	            response_num = len(id2score[index[i]])
615	            if response_num > 1:
616	                scores[i] = scores[i] * response_num / (response_num - 1) - id2mean[index[i]] * response_num / (

618	                )

625	def compute_opo_outcome_advantage(
626	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,

630	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
631	    **kwargs,
632	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
633	    """
634	    Compute advantage for OPO based on https://arxiv.org/pdf/2505.23585
635	
636	    Args:
637	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
638	            shape: (bs, response_length)
639	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
640	            shape: (bs, response_length)
641	        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config
642	
643	    Returns:
644	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
645	            shape: (bs, response_length)
646	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
647	            shape: (bs, response_length)
648	    """
649	    response_length = response_mask.sum(dim=-1)
650	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
651	
652	    id2score = defaultdict(list)
653	    id2len = defaultdict(list)
654	    id2bsl = {}
655	
656	    with torch.no_grad():
657	        bsz = scores.shape[0]
658	        for i in range(bsz):
659	            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
660	            id2len[index[i]].append(response_length[i])
661	
662	        for idx in id2score:
663	            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
664	                id2bsl[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
665	            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
666	                score_tensor = torch.stack(id2score[idx])
667	                len_tensor = torch.stack(id2len[idx])
668	                id2bsl[idx] = (len_tensor * score_tensor).sum() / len_tensor.sum()
669	            else:
670	                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
671	        for i in range(bsz):
672	            scores[i] = scores[i] - id2bsl[index[i]]
673	        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
674	
675	    return scores, scores

678	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.REINFORCE_PLUS_PLUS)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("reinforce_plus_plus")
679	def compute_reinforce_plus_plus_outcome_advantage(
680	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor, response_mask: torch.Tensor, config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None, **kwargs
681	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
682	    """
683	    Compute advantage for REINFORCE++.
684	    This implementation is based on the paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
685	
686	    Args:
687	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
688	            shape: (bs, response_length)
689	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
690	            shape: (bs, response_length)
691	        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config
692	
693	    Returns:
694	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
695	            shape: (bs, response_length)
696	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
697	            shape: (bs, response_length)
698	    """
699	    assert config is not None
700	    gamma = config.gamma
701	    with torch.no_grad():
702	        returns = torch.zeros_like(token_level_rewards)
703	        running_return = 0
704	
705	        for t in reversed(range(token_level_rewards.shape[1])):
706	            running_return = token_level_rewards[:, t] + gamma * running_return
707	            returns[:, t] = running_return
708	            # Reset after EOS
709	            running_return = running_return * response_mask[:, t]
710	
711	        advantages = verl_F.masked_whiten(returns, response_mask)
712	        advantages = advantages * response_mask
713	
714	    return advantages, returns

727	    This implementation is based on the paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.10505

729

753	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GPG)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("gpg")
754	def compute_gpg_outcome_advantage(
755	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
756	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
757	    index: np.ndarray,
758	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
759	    f_norm: float = 1.0,
760	    alpha: float = 1.0,
761	    config=None,
762	    **kwargs,
763	):
764	    """
765	    Compute advantage for GPG, operating only on Outcome reward
766	    (with only one scalar reward for each response).
767	    Args:
768	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
769	            shape: (bs, response_length)
770	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
771	            shape: (bs, response_length)
772	        index: `(np.ndarray)`
773	            shape: (bs,)
774	        epsilon: (float)
775	        f_norm: (float)
776	        alpha: (float)
777	        config: (dict) algorithm config
778	
779	    Returns:
780	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
781	            shape: (bs, response_length)
782	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
783	            shape: (bs, response_length)
784	    """
785	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
786	
787	    id2score = defaultdict(list)
788	    id2mean = {}
789	    id2std = {}
790	
791	    with torch.no_grad():
792	        bsz = scores.shape[0]
793	        m = torch.count_nonzero(scores)
794	        alpha = bsz / m.clamp(min=1)
795	
796	        for i in range(bsz):
797	            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
798	
799	        for idx in id2score:
800	            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
801	                id2mean[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
802	                id2std[idx] = torch.tensor(1.0)
803	            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
804	                scores_tensor = torch.stack(id2score[idx])
805	                id2mean[idx] = torch.mean(scores_tensor)
806	                id2std[idx] = torch.std(scores_tensor)
807	            else:
808	                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
809	        for i in range(bsz):
810	            scores[i] = alpha * (scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]) / (f_norm)
811	        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
812	
813	    return scores, scores
814

816	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.RLOO_VECTORIZED)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("rloo_vectorized")
817	def compute_rloo_vectorized_outcome_advantage(
818	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
819	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
820	    index: np.ndarray,
821	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
822	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
823	    **kwargs,
824	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
825	    """
826	    Compute advantage for RLOO based on https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14740
827	
828	    Args:
829	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
830	            shape: (bs, response_length)
831	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
832	            shape: (bs, response_length)
833	        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config
834	
835	    Returns:
836	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
837	            shape: (bs, response_length)
838	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
839	            shape: (bs, response_length)
840	    """
841	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
842	
843	    with torch.no_grad():
844	        inv = torch.from_numpy(np.unique(index, return_inverse=True)[1]).to(scores.device)
845	
846	        c = torch.bincount(inv)[inv].to(scores.dtype)
847	        adv = ((c * scores - torch.bincount(inv, weights=scores)[inv]) / (c - 1).clamp_min(1)) * (c > 1)
848	
849	        adv = adv.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
850	
851	    return adv, adv

854	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.OPTIMAL_TOKEN_BASELINE)
855	def compute_optimal_token_baseline_advantage(
856	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
857	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
858	    index: np.ndarray,
859	    old_log_probs: torch.Tensor,
860	    sum_pi_squared: torch.Tensor,
861	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor = None,
862	    handle_zero_tail: bool = True,
863	    epsilon: float = 1e-8,
864	    **kwargs,
865	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
866	    """
867	    Compute advantages using Optimal Token Baseline (OTB).
868	
869	    Unlike the group mean based baseline which uses a single baseline per trajectory,
870	    this computes a unique baseline for each timestep using cumulative path variance.
871	
872	    Theory:
873	        For each timestep t in each prompt group:
874	            B_t* = E[G_t × W_t] / E[W_t]
875	        where W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t ||s_j||² (cumulative path-variance proxy)
876	        and ||s_j||² = 1 - 2π_j + Σπ²
877	
878	    The cumulative sum W_t captures the "realized energy" of trajectory has been up to timestep t,
879	    giving higher weight to predicting rewards on high-variance paths.
880	
881	    Args:
882	        token_level_rewards: Rewards at each token position [shape: (bs, response_length)]
883	        response_mask: Binary mask for valid tokens (1) vs padding (0) [shape: (bs, response_length)]
884	        index: Prompt indices for grouping trajectories from same prompt [shape: (bs,)]
885	        old_log_probs: Log probabilities from training policy during generation [shape: (bs, response_length)]
886	        sum_pi_squared: Sum of squared probabilities over vocabulary Σπ² [shape: (bs, response_length)]
887	        rollout_is_weights: Pre-computed IS weights for W correction [shape: (bs, response_length)],
888	            None if not using IS
889	        handle_zero_tail: If True, zero baselines will be set in the portion of the longest trajectory
890	            that extends beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
891	            Default: True
892	        epsilon: Small constant for numerical stability (default: 1e-8)
893	
894	    Returns:
895	        advantages: OTB advantage estimates [shape: (bs, response_length)]
896	        returns: Cumulative rewards (returns) from each position [shape: (bs, response_length)]
897	
898	    Note on Rollout Importance Sampling:
899	        When rollout_is_weights is provided, W_t is scaled by ρ̄²(t) to minimize MSE under truncated IS:
900	            B_t* = Σ[G_t × ρ̄²(t) × W_t] / Σ[ρ̄²(t) × W_t]
901	    """
902	    with torch.no_grad():
903	        batch_size, seq_len = token_level_rewards.shape
904	        device = token_level_rewards.device
905	
906	        # Compute returns (reward-to-go) for each timestep
907	        returns = (token_level_rewards * response_mask).flip(dims=[-1]).cumsum(dim=-1).flip(dims=[-1])
908	
909	        # Step 1: Compute w_per_timestep = 1 - 2π_t + Σπ²)
910	        pi_t = torch.exp(old_log_probs)
911	        w_per_timestep = 1 - 2 * pi_t + sum_pi_squared
912	
913	        # Step 2: Apply rollout importance sampling correction (if enabled)
914	        if rollout_is_weights is not None:
915	            # Scale W by ρ̄² to minimize MSE under truncated IS
916	            w_per_timestep = w_per_timestep * (rollout_is_weights**2)
917	
918	        # Step 3: Compute cumulative path-variance proxy: W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t w_j
919	        # This measures accumulated variance from the start of the trajectory up to timestep t
920	        w_cumulative = (w_per_timestep * response_mask).cumsum(dim=-1)
921	
922	        # Group trajectories by prompt
923	        prompt_groups = defaultdict(list)
924	        for i in range(batch_size):
925	            prompt_groups[index[i]].append(i)
926	
927	        # Initialize baselines tensor [batch_size, seq_len]
928	        baselines = torch.zeros_like(returns)
929	
930	        # Compute per-step baseline for each prompt group
931	        for _, trajectory_indices in prompt_groups.items():
932	            N = len(trajectory_indices)
933	            if N == 1:
934	                # Single trajectory - no baseline (advantage = return)
935	                continue
936	
937	            traj_idx = torch.tensor(trajectory_indices, device=device)
938	
939	            # Extract group data [N, seq_len]
940	            returns_group = returns[traj_idx]
941	            w_cumulative_group = w_cumulative[traj_idx]
942	            mask_group = response_mask[traj_idx]
943	
944	            # Compute per-timestep baseline: B_t = Σ[G_t × W_t] / Σ[W_t]
945	            # where W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t ||s_j||² (cumulative path variance)
946	            # Shape: [seq_len]
947	            numerator = (returns_group * w_cumulative_group * mask_group).sum(dim=0)  # Sum over trajectories
948	            denominator = (w_cumulative_group * mask_group).sum(dim=0) + epsilon
949	
950	            baseline_per_step = numerator / denominator  # [seq_len]
951	
952	            # Assign to all trajectories in this group
953	            baselines[traj_idx] = baseline_per_step.unsqueeze(0).expand(N, -1)
954	
955	            if handle_zero_tail:
956	                # Optionally zero out the portion of the longest trajectory that extends
957	                # beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
958	                response_lengths = mask_group.sum(dim=-1)
959	                sorted_lengths, _ = torch.sort(response_lengths)
960	                max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-1].item())
961	                second_max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-2].item())
962	                max_length_idx = (response_lengths == max_length).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
963	                if max_length_idx.numel() == 1 and max_length > second_max_length:
964	                    max_length_traj_idx = trajectory_indices[int(max_length_idx[0])]
965	                    baselines[max_length_traj_idx, second_max_length:] = 0.0
966	
967	        # Compute advantages: A_t = G_t - B_t
968	        advantages = (returns - baselines) * response_mask
969	
970	    return advantages, returns
971
